titleEnglish: 1 · On Longing and the Complaint of Love

verses.ar: أَمِنْ تَذَكُّرِ جِيرَانٍ بِذِي سَلَمِ ۞ مَزَجْتَ دَمْعًا جَرَى مِنْ مُقْلَةٍ بِدَمِ
verses.tr: Amin tadhakkuri jīrānin bi dhī salami · Mazajta damʿan jarā min muqlatin bidami
verses.en: Is it from recalling the neighbours at Dhū Salam that you mixed with blood the tears streaming from your eyes?

verses.ar: أَمْ هَبَّتِ الرِّيحُ مِنْ تِلْقَاءِ كَاظِمَةٍ ۞ وَأَوْمَضَ الْبَرْقُ فِي الظَّلْمَاءِ مِنْ إِضَمِ
verses.tr: Am habbatir rīhu min tilqāʾi kādhimatin · Wa awmaḍal barqu fīẓ ẓulmāʾi min iḍami
verses.en: Or is it that a wind blew from the direction of Kāẓima, and lightning flashed in the darkness from Iḍam?

verses.ar: فَمَا لِعَيْنَيْكَ إِنْ قُلْتَ اكْفُفَا هَمَتَا ۞ وَمَا لِقَلْبِكَ إِنْ قُلْتَ اسْتَفِقْ يَهِمِ
verses.tr: Famā li ʿaynayka in qultakfufā hamatā · Wa mā li qalbika in qultastafiq yahimi
verses.en: What ails your eyes, that when you tell them 'cease' they weep the more? And what ails your heart, that when you tell it 'come to your senses' it strays deeper?

verses.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ الصَّبُّ أَنَّ الْحُبَّ مُنْكَتِمٌ ۞ مَا بَيْنَ مُنْسَجِمٍ مِنْهُ وَمُضْطَرِمِ
verses.tr: Ayaḥsabuṣ ṣabbu annal ḥubba munkatimun · Mā bayna munsajimin minhu wa muḍṭarimi
verses.en: Does the love-stricken one imagine that love can stay hidden between the tears that pour from him and the fire that blazes within?

verses.ar: لَوْلاَ الْهَوَى لَمْ تَرِقْ دَمْعًا عَلٰى طَلَلٍ ۞ وَلاَ أَرِقْتَ لِذِكْرِ الْبَانِ وَالْعَلَمِ
verses.tr: Lawlal hawā lam turiq damʿan ʿalā ṭalalin · Wa lā ariqta li dhikril bāni wal ʿalami
verses.en: Were it not for love, you would not have shed tears over an abandoned ruin, nor lain awake at the mention of the willow tree and the mountain.

verses.ar: فَكَيْفَ تُنْكِرُ حُبًّا بَعْدَمَا شَهِدَتْ ۞ بِهِ عَلَيْكَ عُدُولُ الدَّمْعِ وَالسَّقَمِ
verses.tr: Fakayfa tunkiru ḥubban baʿda mā shahidat · Bihi ʿalayka ʿudūlud damʿi was saqami
verses.en: So how can you deny love, when the upright witnesses of tears and sickness have testified against you?

verses.ar: وَأَثْبَتَ الْوَجْدُ خَطَّيْ عَبْرَةٍ وَضَنىً ۞ مِثْلَ الْبَهَارِ عَلٰى خَدَّيْكَ وَالعَنَمِ
verses.tr: Wa athbatal wajdu khaṭṭay ʿabratin wa ḍanā · Mithlal bahāri ʿalā khaddayka wal ʿanami
verses.en: Yearning has traced two lines upon your cheeks — of tears and of wasting — like yellow blossom and red ʿanam.

verses.ar: نَعَمْ سَرَى طَيْفُ مَنْ أَهْوَى فَأَرَّقَنِي ۞ وَالحُبُّ يَعْتَرِضُ اللَّذَّاتِ بِالأَلَمِ
verses.tr: Naʿam sarā ṭayfu man ahwā fa arraqanī · Wal ḥubbu yaʿtariḍul ladhdhati bil alami
verses.en: Yes — the phantom of the one I love passed by in the night and robbed me of sleep; love ever crosses its pleasures with pain.

verses.ar: يَا لاَئِمِي فِي الْهَوَى الْعُذْرِيِّ مَعْذِرَةً ۞ مِنِّي إِلَيْكَ وَلَوْ أَنْصَفْتَ لَمْ تَلُمِ
verses.tr: Yā lāʾimī fīl hawal ʿudhriyyi maʿdhiratan · Minnī ilayka wa law anṣafta lam talumi
verses.en: O you who blame me for this chaste love — I ask you to excuse me; had you been fair, you would not have blamed at all.

verses.ar: عَدَتْكَ حَالِي لاَ سِرِّي بِمُسْتَتِرٍ ۞ عَنِ الْوُشَاةِ وَلاَ دَائِي بِمُنْحَسِمِ
verses.tr: ʿAdatka ḥāliya lā sirrī bi mustatirin · ʿAnil wushāti wa lā dāʾī bimunḥasimi
verses.en: May my state never befall you: my secret is not hidden from the slanderers, nor is my affliction brought to an end.

verses.ar: مَحَّضْتَنِي النُّصْحَ لٰكِنْ لَسْتُ أَسْمَعُهُ ۞ إِنَّ الْمُحِبَّ عَنْ الْعُذَّالِ فِي صَمَمِ
verses.tr: Maḥḥaḍtanī nuṣḥa lākin lastu asmaʿuhu · Innal muḥibba ʿanil ʿudhdhāli fī ṣamami
verses.en: You gave me sincere counsel, yet I do not heed it — the lover is deaf to those who reproach him.

verses.ar: إِنِّي اتَّهَمْتُ نَصِيحَ الشَّيْبِ فِي عَذَليِ ۞ وَالشَّيْبُ أَبْعَدُ فِي نُصْحِ عَنِ التُّهَمِ
verses.tr: Innit tahamtu naṣīḥash shaybi fī ʿadhalī · Wash shaybu abʿadu fī nuṣḥin ʿanit tuhami
verses.en: I have even held suspect the counsel of my grey hairs in their reproach — though grey hair, in its counsel, is the furthest from suspicion.

titleEnglish: 2 · On Warning against the Caprice of the Self

verses.ar: فَإِنَّ أَمَّارَتيِ بِالسُّوءِ مَا اتَّعَظَتْ ۞ مِنْ جَهْلِهَا بِنَذِيرِ الشَّيْبِ وَالهَرَمِ
verses.tr: Fa inna ammāratī bis sūʾi mat taʿaẓat · Min jahlihā bi nadhīrish shaybi wal harami
verses.en: For my soul, ever commanding evil, took no warning — in its ignorance — from the warner of grey hair and old age.

verses.ar: وَلاَ أَعَدَّتْ مِنَ الْفِعْلِ الْجَمِيلِ قِرَى ۞ ضَيْفٍ أَلَمَّ بِرَأْسِي غَيْرَ مُحْتَشِمِ
verses.tr: Wa lā aʿaddat minal fiʿlil jamīli qirā · Ḍayfin alamma bi raʾsī ghayra muḥtashimi
verses.en: Nor did it prepare, from beautiful deeds, any welcome for the guest that settled upon my head without shame.

verses.ar: لَوْ كُنْتُ أَعْلَمُ أَنِّي مَا أُوَقِّرُهُ ۞ كَتَمْتُ سِرًّا بَدَاليِ مَنْهُ بِالكَتَمِ
verses.tr: Law kuntu aʿlamu annī mā uwaqqiruhu · Katamtu sirran badālī minhu bil katami
verses.en: Had I known I would fail to honour it, I would have concealed with dye the secret its arrival laid bare.

verses.ar: مَنْ لِي بِرَدِّ جِمَاحٍ مِنْ غَوَايَتِهَا ۞ كَمَا يُرَدُّ جِمَاحُ الْخَيْلِ بِاللُّجُمِ
verses.tr: Man lī biraddi jimāḥin min ghiwāyatihā · Kamā yuraddu jimāḥul khayli bil lujumi
verses.en: Who will help me curb the bolting of my soul from its waywardness, as a bolting horse is curbed with the bridle?

verses.ar: فَلاَ تَرُمْ بِالمَعَاصِي كَسْرَ شَهْوَتِهَا ۞ إِنَّ الطَّعَامَ يُقَوِّي شَهْوَةَ النَّهِمِ
verses.tr: Falā tarum bil maʿāṣī kasra shahwatihā · Innaṭ ṭaʿāma yuqawwī shahwatan nahimi
verses.en: Do not seek to break its craving by yielding to sins — food only strengthens the craving of the glutton.

verses.ar: وَالنَّفْسُ كَالطِّفِلِ إِنْ تُهْمِلْهُ شَبَّ عَلٰى ۞ حُبِّ الرَّضَاعِ وَإِنْ تَفْطِمْهُ يَنْفَطِمِ
verses.tr: Wan nafsu kaṭṭifli in tuhmilhu shabba ʿalā · Ḥubbir raḍāʿi wa in tafṭimhu yanfaṭimi
verses.en: The soul is like an infant: neglect it, and it grows up still loving to suckle; but wean it, and it is weaned.

verses.ar: فَاصْرِفْ هَوَاهَا وَحَاذِرْ أَنْ تُوَلِّيَهُ ۞ إِنَّ الْهَوَى مَا تَوَلَّى يُصْمِ أَوْ يَصِمِ
verses.tr: Faṣrif hawāhā wa ḥādhir an tuwalliyahu · Innal hawā mā tawallā yuṣmi aw yaṣimi
verses.en: So turn away its desire, and beware of giving it charge — desire, once given charge, destroys or disgraces.

verses.ar: وَرَاعِهَا وَهِيَ فِي الْأَعْمَالِ سَائِمَةٌ ۞ وَإِنْ هِيَ اسْتَحْلَتِ الْمَرْعَى فَلاَ تُسِمِ
verses.tr: Wa rāʿihā wa hiya fīl aʿmāli sāʾimatun · Wa in hiyastaḥlatil marʿā falā tusimi
verses.en: Tend it while it grazes among deeds; and should it find the pasture sweet, do not let it roam free.

verses.ar: كَمْ حَسَّنَتْ لَذَّةً لِلْمَرْءِ قَاتِلَةً ۞ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَمْ يَدْرِ أَنَّ السُّمَّ فِي الدَّسَمِ
verses.tr: Kam ḥassanat ladhdhatan lil marʾi qātilatan · Min ḥaythu lam yadri annas summa fid dasami
verses.en: How often it has made a deadly pleasure seem fair to a man, where he did not realise the poison lay within the rich food.

verses.ar: وَاخْشَ الدَّسَائِسَ مِنْ جُوعٍ وَمِنْ شِبَعٍ ۞ فَرُبَّ مَخْمَصَةٍ شَرُّ مِنَ التُّخَمِ
verses.tr: Wakhshad dasāʾisa min jūʿin wa min shibaʿin · Farubba makhmaṣatin sharrun minat tukhami
verses.en: Fear the hidden snares in both hunger and satiety — many a bout of hunger is worse than a bout of overeating.

verses.ar: وَاسْتَفْرِغِ الدَّمْعَ مِنْ عَيْنٍ قَدِ امْتَلَأَتْ ۞ مِنَ الْمَحَارِمِ وَالْزَمْ حِمْيَةَ النَّدَمِ
verses.tr: Wastafrighid damʿa min ʿaynin qadimtalaʾat · Minal maḥārimi walzam ḥimyatan nadami
verses.en: Empty of tears an eye that has filled itself with forbidden sights, and hold fast to the diet of remorse.

verses.ar: وَخَالِفِ النَّفْسَ وَالشَّيْطَانَ وَاعْصِهِمَا ۞ وَإِنْ هُمَا مَحَضَاكَ النُّصْحَ فَاتَّهِمِ
verses.tr: Wa khālifin nafsa wash shayṭāna waʿṣihimā · Wa in humā maḥaḍākan nuṣḥa fat tahimi
verses.en: Oppose the soul and Satan, and disobey them both; and if they offer you sincere-seeming counsel, hold it suspect.

verses.ar: وَلاَ تُطِعْ مِنْهُمَا خَصْمًا وَلاَ حَكَمًا ۞ فَأَنْتَ تَعْرِفُ كَيْدَ الْخَصْمِ وَالحَكَمِ
verses.tr: Wa lā tuṭiʿ minhumā khaṣman walā ḥakaman · Fa anta taʿrifu kaydal khaṣmi wal ḥakami
verses.en: Obey neither of them as adversary nor as arbiter — for you well know the cunning of the adversary and the arbiter.

verses.ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّٰهَ مِنْ قَوْلٍ بِلاَ عَمَلٍ ۞ لَقَدْ نَسَبْتُ بِهِ نَسْلاً لِذِي عُقُمِ
verses.tr: AstaghfiruLlāha min qawlin bilā ʿamalin · Laqad nasbtu bihi naslan lidhī ʿuqumi
verses.en: I seek Allah's forgiveness for words unmatched by deeds — by them I have ascribed offspring to one who is barren.

verses.ar: أَمَرْتُكَ الْخَيْرَ لٰكِنْ مَا ائْتَمَرْتُ بِهِ ۞ وَمَا اسْتَقَمْتُ فَمَا قَوْليِ لَكَ اسْتَقِمِ
verses.tr: Amartukal khayra lākin māʾtamartu bihi · Wa māstaqamtu famā qawlī lakastaqimi
verses.en: I bade you do good, yet did not heed it myself; I was not upright — so what worth is my saying to you, 'Be upright'?

verses.ar: وَلاَ تَزَوَّدْتُ قَبْلَ الْمَوْتِ نَافِلَةً ۞ وَلَمْ أُصَلِّ سِوَى فَرْضٍ وَلَمْ أَصُمِ
verses.tr: Wa lā tazawwadtu qablal mawti nāfīlatan · Wa lam uṣalli siwā farḍin wa lam aṣumi
verses.en: Nor did I lay up, before death, any voluntary works; I prayed nothing beyond the obligatory, and I did not fast.

titleEnglish: 3 · In Praise of the Prophet ﷺ

verses.ar: ظَلَمْتُ سُنَّةَ مَنْ أَحْيَا الظَّلاَمَ إِلَى ۞ أَنِ اشْتَكَتْ قَدَمَاهُ الضُّرَّ مِنْ وَرَمِ
verses.tr: Ẓalamtu sunnata man aḥyādh ẓalāma ilā · Anishtakat qadamāhuḍ ḍurra min warami
verses.en: I have wronged the way of him who kept the nights alive in prayer until his feet complained of the hurt of swelling.

verses.ar: وَشَدَّ مِنْ سَغَبٍ أَحْشَاءَهُ وَطَوَى ۞ تَحْتَ الْحِجَارَةِ كَشْحًا مُتْرَفَ الْأَدَمِ
verses.tr: Wa shadda min saghabin aḥshāʾahu wa ṭawā · Taḥtal ḥijārati kash-ḥan mutrafal adami
verses.en: From hunger he bound in his belly, and folded beneath a stone a waist of soft and delicate skin.

verses.ar: وَرَاوَدَتْهُ الْجِبَالُ الشُّمُّ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ ۞ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ فَأَرَاهَا أَيَّمَا شَمَمِ
verses.tr: Wa rāwadat-hul jibālush shummu min dhahabin · ʿAn nafsihi fa arāhā ayyamā shamami
verses.en: The lofty mountains offered to become gold to tempt him, but he showed them a loftiness far above their own.

verses.ar: وَأَكَّدَتْ زُهْدَهُ فِيهَا ضَرُورَتُهُ ۞ إِنَّ الضَّرُورَةَ لاَ تَعْدُو عَلٰى الْعِصَمِ
verses.tr: Wa akkadat zuhdahu fīhā ḍarūratuhu · Innaḍ ḍarūrata lā taʿdū ʿalal ʿiṣami
verses.en: His very need only confirmed his detachment from them — for need never transgresses against the divinely protected.

verses.ar: وَكَيْفَ تَدْعُو إِلَى الدُّنْيَا ضَرُورَةُ مَنْ ۞ لَوْلاَهُ لَمْ تُخْرَجِ الدُّنْيَا مِنَ الْعَدَمِ
verses.tr: Wa kayfa tadʿū ilad dunyā ḍarūratu man · Lawlāhu lam tukhrajid dunyā minal ʿadami
verses.en: And how could need summon to worldliness the one but for whom the world would never have been drawn out of nothingness?

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ سَيِّدُ الْكَوْنَيْنِ وَالثَّقَلَيْنِ ۞ وَالفَرِيقَيْنِ مِنْ عُرْبٍ وَمِنْ عَجَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun sayyidul kawnayni wath thaqalayni · wal farīqayni min ʿurbin wa min ʿajami
verses.en: Muhammad, master of the two worlds, of both jinn and mankind, and of the two peoples, Arab and non-Arab.

verses.ar: نَبِيُّنَا الْآمِرُ النَّاهِي فَلاَ أَحَدٌ ۞ أَبَرَّ فِي قَوْلِ لاَ مِنْهُ وَلاَ نَعَمِ
verses.tr: Nabiyyunal āmirun nāhī falā aḥadun · Abarra fī qawli lā minhu wa lā naʿami
verses.en: Our Prophet, who commands and forbids — none is more truthful than he in a 'no' or a 'yes'.

verses.ar: هُوَ الْحَبِيبُ الذِّي تُرْجَى شَفَاعَتُهُ ۞ لِكُلِّ هَوْلٍ مِنَ الْأَهْوَالِ مُقْتَحَمِ
verses.tr: Huwal ḥabībul ladhī turjā shafāʿatuhu · Li kulli hawlin minal ahwāli muqtaḥami
verses.en: He is the Beloved whose intercession is hoped for against every terror that comes crashing down.

verses.ar: دَعَا إِلَى اللّٰهِ فَالْمُسْتَمْسِكُونَ بِهِ ۞ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ بِحَبْلٍ غَيْرِ مُنْفَصِمِ
verses.tr: Daʿā ilaLlāhi fal mustamsikūna bihi · Mustamsikūna biḥablin ghayri munfaṣimi
verses.en: He called to Allah; so those who hold fast to him hold fast to a rope that will never break.

verses.ar: فَاقَ النَّبِيّينَ فِي خَلْقٍ وَفِي خُلُقٍ ۞ وَلَمْ يُدَانُوهُ فِي عِلْمٍ وَلاَ كَرَمِ
verses.tr: Fāqan nabiyyīna fī khalqin wa fī khuluqin · Wa lam yudānūhu fī ʿilmin wa lā karami
verses.en: He surpassed the Prophets in form and in character, and they did not draw near him in knowledge or in nobility.

verses.ar: وَكُلُّهُمْ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللّٰهِ مُلْتَمِسٌ ۞ غَرْفًا مِنَ الْبَحْرِ أَوْ رَشْفًا مِنَ الدِّيَمِ
verses.tr: Wa kulluhum min rasūliLlāhi multamisun · Gharfan minal baḥri aw rashfan minad diyami
verses.en: Each of them seeks from the Emissary of Allah a handful from his sea, or a sip from his gentle rains.

verses.ar: وَوَاقِفُونَ لَدَيْهِ عِنْدَ حَدِّهِمِ ۞ مِنْ نُقْطَةِ الْعِلْمِ أَوْ مِنْ شَكْلَةِ الْحِكَمِ
verses.tr: Wa wāqifūna ladayhi ʿinda ḥaddihimi · Min nuqṭatil ʿilmi aw min shaklatil ḥikami
verses.en: And they stand before him, each at his own limit — a single dot of his knowledge, or one vowel-mark of his wisdom.

verses.ar: فَهْوَ الذِّي تَمَّ مَعْنَاهُ وَصُورَتُهُ ۞ ثُمَّ اصْطَفَاهُ حَبِيبًا بَارِئُ النَّسَمِ
verses.tr: Fa huwal ladhī tamma maʿnāhu wa ṣūratuhu · Thummaṣṭafāhu ḥabīban bāriʾun nasami
verses.en: He is the one whose inner meaning and outer form were made perfect; then the Fashioner of souls chose him as His beloved.

verses.ar: مُنَزَّهٌ عَنْ شَرِيكٍ فِي مَحَاسِنِهِ ۞ فَجَوْهَرُ الْحُسْنِ فِيهِ غَيْرُ مُنْقَسِمِ
verses.tr: Munazzahun ʿan sharīkin fī maḥāsinihi · Fa jawharul ḥusni fīhi ghayru munqasimi
verses.en: Far above having any rival in his excellences — for in him the essence of beauty is undivided.

verses.ar: دَعْ مَا ادَّعَتْهُ النَّصَارَى فِي نَبِيِّهِمِ ۞ وَاحْكُمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ مَدْحًا فِيهِ وَاحْتَكِمِ
verses.tr: Daʿ maddaʿat-hun naṣārā fī nabiyyihimi · Waḥkum bimā shiʾta mad-ḥan fīhi waḥtakimi
verses.en: Leave aside what the Christians claimed of their prophet; then decree what praise you will of him, and judge freely.

verses.ar: وَانْسُبْ إِلَى ذَاتِهِ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَرَفٍ ۞ وَانْسُبْ إِلَى قَدْرِهِ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ عِظَمِ
verses.tr: Wansub ilā dhātihi mā shiʾta min sharafin · Wansub ilā qadrihi mā shiʾta min ʿiẓami
verses.en: Ascribe to his person what nobility you will, and ascribe to his rank what greatness you will.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّ فَضْلَ رَسُولِ اللّٰهِ لَيْسَ لَهُ ۞ حَدٌّ فَيُعْرِبَ عَنْهُ نَاطِقٌ بِفَمِ
verses.tr: Fa inna faḍla rasūliLlāhi laysa lahu · Ḥaddun fa yuʿriba ʿanhu nāṭiqun bifami
verses.en: For the excellence of Allah's Emissary has no limit that a speaker could ever put into words with his mouth.

verses.ar: لَوْ نَاسَبَتْ قَدْرَهُ آيَاتُهُ عِظَمًا ۞ أَحْيَا اسْمُهُ حِينَ يُدْعَى دَارِسَ الرِّمَمِ
verses.tr: Law nāsabat qadrahu āyātuhu ʿiẓaman · Aḥyaʾsmuhu ḥīna yudʿā dārisar rimami
verses.en: Had his miracles matched his rank in greatness, the mere calling of his name would revive bones long decayed.

verses.ar: لَمْ يَمْتَحِنَّا بِمَا تَعْيَا الْعُقُولُ بِهِ ۞ حِرْصًا عَلَيْنَا فَلَمْ نَرْتَبْ وَلَمْ نَهِمْ
verses.tr: Lam yamtaḥinnā bimā taʿyal ʿuqūlu bihi · Ḥirṣan ʿalayna falam nartab wa lam nahimi
verses.en: Out of care for us he did not test us with what the minds cannot bear, so we neither doubted nor lost our way.

verses.ar: أَعْيَا الْوَرَى فَهْمُ مَعْنَاهُ فَلَيْسَ يُرَى ۞ فِي الْقُرْبِ وَالْبُعْدِ فِيهِ غَيْرُ مُنْفَحِمِ
verses.tr: Aʿyal warā fahmu maʿnāhu falaysa yurā · Fīl qurbi wal buʿdi fīhi ghayru munfaḥimi
verses.en: Grasping his reality has wearied all creation; near or far, none is seen before him but the dumbstruck.

verses.ar: كَالشَّمْسِ تَظْهَرُ لِلْعَيْنَيْنِ مِنْ بُعُدٍ ۞ صَغِيرَةً وَتُكِلُّ الطَّرْفَ مِنْ أَمَمِ
verses.tr: Kash shamsi taẓ-haru lil ʿaynayni min buʿudin · Ṣaghīratan wa tukilluṭ ṭarfa min amami
verses.en: Like the sun, which appears small to the eyes from afar, yet overwhelms the sight when close at hand.

verses.ar: وَكَيْفَ يُدْرِكُ فِي الدُّنْيَا حَقِيقَتَهُ ۞ قَوْمٌ نِيَامٌ تَسَلَّوْا عَنْهُ بِالحُلُمِ
verses.tr: Wa kayfa yudriku fid dunyā ḥaqīqatahu · Qawmun niyāmun tasallū ʿanhu bil ḥulumi
verses.en: How could his reality be grasped in this world by a sleeping people, content to know him only through dreams?

verses.ar: فَمَبْلَغُ الْعِلْمِ فِيهِ أَنَّهُ بَشَرٌ ۞ وَأَنَّهُ خَيْرُ خَلْقِ اللّٰهِ كُلِّهِمِ
verses.tr: Fa mablaghul ʿilmi fīhi annahu basharun · Wa annahu khayru khalqiLlāhi kullihimi
verses.en: The utmost our knowledge reaches of him is that he is a man, and that he is the best of all Allah's creation.

verses.ar: وَكُلُّ آيٍ أَتَى الرُّسْلُ الْكِرَامُ بِهَا ۞ فَإِنَّمَا اتَّصَلَتْ مِنْ نُوِرِهِ بِهِمِ
verses.tr: Wa kullu āyin atar ruslul kirāmu bihā · Fa innamat taṣalat min nūrihi bihimi
verses.en: Every sign the noble Emissaries brought reached them only through connection with his light.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّهُ شَمْسُ فَضْلٍ هُمْ كَوَاكِبُهَا ۞ يُظْهِرْنَ أَنْوَارَهاَ لِلنَّاسِ فِي الظُّلَمِ
verses.tr: Fa innahu shamsu faḍlin hum kawākibuhā · Yuẓ-hirna anwārahā lin nāsi fidh ẓulami
verses.en: For he is the sun of grace, and they are its stars, showing forth its lights to people in the darkness.

verses.ar: أَكْرِمْ بِخَلْقِ نَبِيٍ زَانَهُ خُلُقٌ ۞ بِالحُسْنِ مُشْتَمِلٍ بِالبِشْرِ مُتَّسِمِ
verses.tr: Akrim bikhalqi nabiyyin zānahu khuluqun · Bil ḥusni mushtamilin bil bishri muttasimi
verses.en: How noble the form of a Prophet adorned by character — wrapped in beauty, marked by a cheerful, smiling face.

verses.ar: كَالزَّهْرِ فِي تَرَفٍ وَالبَدْرِ فِي شَرَفٍ ۞ وَالبَحْرِ فِي كَرَمٍ وَالدَّهْرِ فِي هِمَمِ
verses.tr: Kaz zahri fī tarafin wal badri fī sharafin · Wal baḥri fī karamin wad dahri fī himami
verses.en: Like the flower in delicate beauty, the full moon in honour, the sea in generosity, and all of time in resolve.

verses.ar: كَأَنَّه وَهْوَ فَرْدٌ مِنْ جَلاَلَتِهِ ۞ فِي عَسْكَرٍ حِينَ تَلْقَاهُ وَفِي حَشَمِ
verses.tr: Ka annahu wa huwa fardun min jalālatihi · Fī ʿaskarin ḥīna talqāhu wa fī ḥashami
verses.en: So great his majesty that, though alone when you meet him, he seems amid an army and a retinue.

verses.ar: كَأَنَّمَا اللُّؤْلُؤْ الْمَكْنُونُ فِي صَدَفٍ ۞ مِنْ مَعْدِنَيْ مَنْطِقٍ مِنْهُ وَمُبْتَسِمِ
verses.tr: Ka annamal luʾluʾul maknūnu fī ṣadafin · Min maʿdinay manṭiqin minhu wa mubtasami
verses.en: As if guarded pearls in their shells came forth from the twin mines of his speech and his smile.

verses.ar: لاَ طِيبَ يَعْدِلُ تُرْبًا ضَمَّ أَعْظُمَهُ ۞ طُوبىَ لِمُنْتَشِقٍ مِنْهُ وَمُلْتَثِمِ
verses.tr: Lā ṭība yaʿdilu turban ḍamma aʿẓumahu · Ṭūbā li muntashiqin minhu wa multathimi
verses.en: No perfume equals the earth that embraces his blessed remains; blessed is the one who breathes its scent or kisses it.

verses.ar: أَبَانَ مَوْلِدُهُ عَنْ طِيبِ عُنْصُرِهِ ۞ يَا طِيبَ مُبْتَدَإٍ مِنْهُ وَمُخْتَتَمِ
verses.tr: Abāna mawliduhu ʿan ṭībi ʿunṣurihi · Yā ṭība mubtadaʾin minhu wa mukhtatami
verses.en: His birth made plain the purity of his origin — O how pure were his beginning and his end!

verses.ar: يَوْمٌ تَفَرَّسَ فِيهِ الْفُرْسُ أَنَّهُمُ ۞ قَدْ أُنْذِرُوا بِحُلُولِ الْبُؤْسِ وَالنِّقَمِ
verses.tr: Yawmun tafarrasa fīhil fursu annahumu · Qad undhirū biḥulūlil buʾsi wan niqami
verses.en: A day on which the Persians sensed that they had been warned of the coming of misery and retribution.

verses.ar: وَبَاتَ إِيوَانُ كِسْرَى وَهُوَ مُنْصَدِعٌ ۞ كَشَمْلِ أَصْحَابِ كِسْرَى غَيْرَ مُلْتَئِمِ
verses.tr: Wa bāta īwānu kisrā wa huwa munṣadiʿun · Ka shamli aṣ-ḥābi kisrā ghayra multaʾimi
verses.en: The palace of Chosroes passed the night split apart, like the fellowship of Chosroes' people, never to be made whole again.

verses.ar: وَالنَّارُ خَامِدَةُ الْأَنْفَاسِ مِنْ أَسَفٍ ۞ عَلَيْهِ وَالنَّهْرُ سَاهِي الْعَيْنِ مِنْ سَدَمِ
verses.tr: Wan nāru khāmidatul anfāsi min asafin · ʿAlayhi wan nahru sāhil ʿayni min sadami
verses.en: The sacred fire lay dead of breath from grief over it, and the river ran dry of eye from sorrow.

verses.ar: وَسَاءَ سَاوَةَ أَنْ غَاضَتْ بُحَيْرَتُهَا ۞ وَرُدَّ وَارِدُهَا بِالغَيْظِ حِينَ ظَمِي
verses.tr: Wa sāʾa sāwata an ghāḍat buḥayratuhā · Wa rudda wāriduhā bil ghayẓi ḥīna ẓamī
verses.en: It grieved Sāwa that its lake sank away, and the one who came to it thirsty was turned back in rage.

verses.ar: كَأَنَّ بِالنَّارِ مَا بِالمَاءِ مِنْ بَلَلٍ ۞ حُزْنًا وَبِالمَاءِ مَا بِالنَّارِ مِنْ ضَرَمِ
verses.tr: Ka anna bin nāri mā bil māʾi min balalin · Ḥuznan wa bil māʾi mā bin nāri min ḍarami
verses.en: As though, in grief, the fire held the wetness of water, and the water held the fire's own burning.

verses.ar: وَالجِنُّ تَهْتِفُ وَالأَنْوَارُ سَاطِعَةٌ ۞ وَالحَّقُ يَظْهَرُ مِنْ مَعْنىً وَمِنْ كَلِمِ
verses.tr: Wal jinnu tahtifu wal anwāru sāṭiʿatun · Wal ḥaqqu yaẓ-haru min maʿnan wa min kalimi
verses.en: The jinn cried out, the lights blazed forth, and the Truth appeared in meaning and in word.

verses.ar: عَمُوا وَصَمُّوا فَإِعْلاَنُ الْبَشَائِرِ لَمْ ۞ يُسْمَعْ وَبَارِقَةُ الْإِنْذَارِ لَمْ تُشَمِ
verses.tr: ʿAmmū wa ṣammū fa iʿlānul bashāʾiri lam · Yusmaʿ wa bāriqatul indhāri lam tushami
verses.en: They were blind and deaf: the proclamation of glad tidings went unheard, and the lightning of warning went unheeded.

verses.ar: مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا أَخْبَرَ الْأَقْوَامَ كَاهِنُهُمْ ۞ بِأَنَّ دِينَهُمُ الْمُعْوَجَّ لَمْ يَقُمِ
verses.tr: Min baʿdi mā akhbaral aqwāma kāhinuhum · Bi anna dīnahumul muʿwajja lam yaqumi
verses.en: This, after their soothsayers had told the peoples that their crooked religion would not stand.

verses.ar: وَبَعْدَمَا عَايَنُوا فِي الْأُفْقِ مِنْ شُهُبٍ ۞ مُنْقَضَّةٍ وَفْقَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضَ مِنْ صَنَمِ
verses.tr: Wa baʿda mā ʿāyanū fīl ufqi min shuhubin · Munqaḍḍatin wifqa mā fīl arḍi min ṣanami
verses.en: And after they beheld on the horizon shooting stars falling, matching the idols toppling on the earth.

verses.ar: حَتَّى غَدَا عَنْ طَرِيقِ الْوَحْيِ مُنْهَزِمٌ ۞ مِنَ الشَّيَاطِينِ يَقْفُوا إِثْرَ مُنْهَزِمِ
verses.tr: Ḥattā ghadā ʿan ṭarīqil waḥyī munhazimun · Minash shayāṭīni yaqfū ithra munhazimi
verses.en: Until, from the path of revelation, one routed devil fled following upon another routed one.

verses.ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ هَرَبًا أَبْطَالُ أَبْرَهَةٍ ۞ أَوْ عَسْكَرٍ بِالحَصَى مِنْ رَاحَتَيْهِ رُمِي
verses.tr: Ka annahum haraban abṭālu abrahatin · Aw ʿaskarin bil ḥaṣā min rāḥatayhi rumī
verses.en: In their flight they were like the champions of Abraha, or an army pelted with pebbles from his blessed hands.

verses.ar: نَبْذًا بِهِ بَعْدَ تَسْبِيحٍ بِبَطْنِهِمَا ۞ نَبْذَ الْمُسَبِّحِ مِنْ أَحْشَاءِ مُلْتَقِمِ
verses.tr: Nabdhan bihi baʿda tasbīḥin bi baṭnihimā · Nabdhal musabbiḥi min aḥshāʾi multaqimi
verses.en: Cast out by his hands after they had glorified Allah within his palms, as the glorifier was cast from the belly of the whale.

verses.ar: جَاءَتْ لِدَعْوَتِهِ الْأَشْجَارُ سَاجِدَةً ۞ تَمْشِي إِلَيْهِ عَلٰى سَاقٍ بِلاَ قَدَمِ
verses.tr: Jāʾat li daʿwatihil ashjāru sājidatan · Tamshī ilayhi ʿalā sāqin bilā qadami
verses.en: At his call the trees came prostrating, walking towards him upon trunks without feet.

verses.ar: كَأَنَّمَا سَطَرَتْ سَطْرًا لِمَا كَتَبَتْ ۞ فُرُوعُهَا مِنْ بَدِيعِ الْخَطِّ بِاللَّقَمِ
verses.tr: Ka annamā saṭarat saṭran limā katabat · Furūʿuhā min badīʿil khaṭṭi bil laqami
verses.en: As if their branches, along the path, were tracing out a line of exquisite calligraphy.

verses.ar: مِثْلَ الْغَمَامَةِ أَنَّى سَارَ سَائِرَةً ۞ تَقِيهِ حَرَّ وَطِيسٍ لِلْهَجِيرِ حَمِي
verses.tr: Mithlal ghamāmati annā sāra sāʾiratan · Taqīhi ḥarra waṭīsin lil hajīri ḥamī
verses.en: Like the cloud that travelled wherever he went, shielding him from the blazing furnace of the noonday heat.

verses.ar: أَقْسَمْتُ بِالْقَمَرِ الْمُنْشَقِّ إِنَّ لَهُ ۞ مِنْ قَلْبِهِ نِسْبَةً مَبْرُورَةَ الْقَسَمِ
verses.tr: Aqsamtu bil qamaril munshaqqi inna lahu · Min qalbihi nisbatan mabrūratal qasami
verses.en: I swear by the moon that was split in two — a true oath — that it bears a bond with his heart.

verses.ar: وَمَا حَوَى الْغَارُ مِنْ خَيْرٍ وَمِنْ كَرَمِ ۞ وَكُلُّ طَرْفٍ مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ عَنْهُ عَمِي
verses.tr: Wa mā ḥawal ghāru min khayrin wa min karamin · Wa kullu ṭarfin minal kuffāri ʿanhu ʿamī
verses.en: And by the goodness and nobility the cave contained, while every disbeliever's eye was blind to him.

verses.ar: فَالصِّدْقُ فِي الْغَارِ وَالصِّدِّيقُ لَمْ يَرِمَا ۞ وَهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا بِالْغَارِ مِنْ أَرِمِ
verses.tr: Faṣ ṣidqu fīl ghāri waṣ ṣiddīqu lam yarimā · Wa hum yaqūlūna mā bil ghāri min arimi
verses.en: Truthfulness itself and the Truthful One never stirred from the cave, while they were saying, 'No living soul is within it.'

verses.ar: ظَنُّوا الْحَمَامَ وَظَنُّوا الْعَنْكَبُوتَ عَلٰى ۞ خَيْرِ الْبَرِيَّةِ لَمْ تَنْسُجْ وَلَمْ تَحُمِ
verses.tr: Ẓannul ḥamāma wa ẓannul ʿankabūta ʿalā · Khayril bariyyati lam tansuj wa lam taḥumi
verses.en: They imagined no dove had hovered, and no spider had woven its web, over the Best of Creation.

verses.ar: وِقَايَةُ اللّٰهِ أَغْنَتْ عَنْ مُضَاعَفَةٍ ۞ مِنَ الدُّرُوعِ وَعَنْ عَالٍ مِنَ الْأُطُمِ
verses.tr: WiqāyatuLlāhi aghnat ʿan muḍāʿafatin · Minad durūʿi wa ʿan ʿālin minal uṭumi
verses.en: Allah's protection made them need no layered coats of mail, nor any towering fortress.

verses.ar: مَا سَامَنِي الدَّهْرُ ضَيْمًا وَاسْتَجَرْتُ بِهِ ۞ إِلْاَّ وَنِلْتُ جِوَارًا مِنْهُ لَمْ يُضَمِ
verses.tr: Mā sāmanid dahru ḍayman wastajartu bihi · Illā wa niltu jiwāran minhu lam yuḍami
verses.en: Never did fate impose some wrong on me and I sought refuge in him, but that I gained a sanctuary with him where no wrong could reach.

verses.ar: وَلاَ الْتَمَسْتُ غِنَى الدَّارَيْنِ مِنْ يَدِهِ ۞ إِلْاَّ اسْتَلَمْتُ النَّدَى مِنْ خَيْرِ مُسْتَلَمِ
verses.tr: Wa laltamastu ghinad dārayni min yadihi · Illāstalamtun nadā min khayri mustalami
verses.en: Nor did I seek the riches of both worlds from his hand but that I received bounty from the best of all to be approached.

verses.ar: لاَ تُنْكِرِ الْوَحْيَ مِنْ رُؤْيَاهُ إِنَّ لَهُ ۞ قَلْبًا إِذَا نَامَتِ الْعَيْنَانِ لَمْ يَنَمِ
verses.tr: Lā tunkiril waḥya min ruʾyāhu inna lahu · Qalban idhā nāmatil ʿaynāni lam yanami
verses.en: Do not deny the revelation that came in his dreams — for he had a heart that did not sleep when the two eyes slept.

verses.ar: وَذَاكَ حِينَ بُلُوغٍ مِنْ نُبَوَّتِهِ ۞ فَلَيْسَ يُنْكَرُ فِيهِ حَالُ مُحْتَلِمِ
verses.tr: Wa dhāka ḥīna bulūghin min nubuwwatihi · Fa laysa yunkaru fīhi ḥālu muḥtalimi
verses.en: That was at the onset of his prophethood; so the dreaming of one full-grown in it cannot be denied.

verses.ar: تَبَارَكَ اللّٰهُ مَا وَحَيٌ بِمُكْتَسَبٍ ۞ وَلاَ نَبيُّ عَلٰى غَيْبٍ بِمُتَّهَمِ
verses.tr: Tabārak Allahu mā waḥyun bi muktasabin · Wa lā nabiyyun ʿalā ghaybin bi muttahami
verses.en: Blessed is Allah — revelation is not a thing acquired by effort, nor is a Prophet to be doubted concerning the Unseen.

verses.ar: كَمْ أَبْرَأَتْ وَصِبًا بِاللَّمْسِ رَاحَتُهُ ۞ وَأَطْلَقَتْ أَرِبًا مِنْ رِبْقَةِ اللَّمَمِ
verses.tr: Kam abraʾat waṣiban bil lamsi rāḥatuhu · Wa aṭlaqat ariban min ribqatil lamami
verses.en: How many an invalid his palm healed with a touch, and how many it freed from the noose of madness!

verses.ar: وَأَحْيَتِ السَّنَةَ الشَّهْبَاءَ دَعْوَتُهُ ۞ حَتَّى حَكَتْ غُرَّةً فِي الْأَعْصُرِ الدُّهُمِ
verses.tr: Wa aḥyatis sanatash shahbāʾa daʿwatuhu · Ḥattā ḥakat ghurratan fīl aʿṣurid duhumi
verses.en: His supplication revived the year of grey drought, till it shone out like a white blaze amid the dark ages.

verses.ar: بِعَارضٍ جَادَ أَوْ خِلْتَ الْبِطَاحَ بِهَا ۞ سَيْبًا مِنَ الْيَمِّ أَوْ سَيْلاً مِنَ الْعَرِمِ
verses.tr: Bi ʿāriḍin jāda aw khiltal biṭāḥa bihā · Sayban minal yammi aw saylan minal ʿarimi
verses.en: With a rain-cloud so generous you would think the valleys ran with a flow from the sea, or the bursting flood of ʿArim.

titleEnglish: 6 · On the Nobility of the Qur'an

verses.ar: دَعْنيِ وَوَصْفِي آيَاتٍ لَهُ ظَهَرَتْ ۞ ظُهُورَ نَارِ الْقِرَى لَيْلاً عَلٰى عَلَمِ
verses.tr: Daʿnī wa waṣfī āyātin lahu ẓaharat · Ẓuhūra nāril qirā laylan ʿalā ʿalami
verses.en: Leave me to describe the signs made manifest through him — plain as a host's welcoming fire lit at night upon a hill.

verses.ar: فَالدُّرُّ يَزْدَادُ حُسْنًا وَهْوَ مُنْتَظِمٌ ۞ وَلَيْسَ يَنْقُصُ قَدْرًا غَيْرَ مُنْتَظِمِ
verses.tr: Fad durru yazdādu ḥusnan wa huwa muntaẓimun · Wa laysa yanquṣu qadran ghayra muntaẓimi
verses.en: The pearl grows lovelier when strung in order, yet loses no worth when it is left unstrung.

verses.ar: فَمَا تَطَاوُلُ آمَالِ الْمَديحِ إِلَى ۞ مَا فِيهِ مِنْ كَرَمِ الْأَخْلاَقِ وَالشِّيَمِ
verses.tr: Famā taṭāwulu āmālil madīḥi ilā · Mā fīhi min karamil akhlāqi wash shiyami
verses.en: How could the aspirations of praise ever reach up to the nobility of character and disposition that is in him?

verses.ar: آيَاتُ حَقٍّ مِنَ الرَّحْمَانِ مُحْدَثَةٌ ۞ قَدِيمَةٌ صِفَةُ الْمَوْصُوفِ بِالقِدَمِ
verses.tr: Āyātu ḥaqqin minar raḥmāni muḥdathatun · Qadīmatun ṣifatul mawṣūfi bil qidami
verses.en: Signs of truth from the All-Merciful: new in their revealing, ancient as the attribute of Him described by pre-eternity.

verses.ar: لَمْ تَقْتَرِنْ بِزَمِانٍ وَهْيَ تُخْبِرُنَا ۞ عَنْ الْمَعَادِ وَعَنْ عَادٍ وَعَنْ إِرَمِ
verses.tr: Lam taqtarin bizamānin wa hiya tukhbirunā · ʿAnil maʿādi wa ʿan ʿādin wa ʿan irami
verses.en: They are bound to no age, yet they tell us of the Return, and of ʿĀd, and of Iram.

verses.ar: دَامَتْ لَدَيْنَا فَفَاقَتْ كُلَّ مُعْجِزَةٍ ۞ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ إِذْ جَاءَتْ وَلَمْ تَدُمِ
verses.tr: Dāmat ladaynā fafāqat kulla muʿjizatin · Minan nabiyyīna idh jāʾat wa lam tadumi
verses.en: They endure with us, and so surpass every miracle of the Prophets, which came and did not remain.

verses.ar: مُحْكَّمَاتٌ فَمَا تُبْقِيْنَ مِنْ شُبَهٍ ۞ لِذِي شِقَاقٍ وَمَا تَبْغِيْنَ مِنْ حَكَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥkamātun famā tubqīna min shubahin · Lidhī shiqāqin wa mā tabghīna min ḥakami
verses.en: Verses so clear they leave no doubt for the contentious, and stand in need of no arbiter.

verses.ar: مَا حُورِبَتْ قَطُّ إِلْاَّ عَادَ مِنْ حَرَبٍ ۞ أَعْدَى الْأَعَادِي إِلَيْهَا مُلْقِيَ السَّلَمِ
verses.tr: Mā ḥūribat qaṭṭu illā ʿāda min ḥarabin · Aʿdal aʿādī ilayhā mulqiyas salami
verses.en: Never were they assailed but that the fiercest of foes came back from the battle, laying down his arms in surrender to them.

verses.ar: رَدَّتْ بَلاَغَتُهَا دَعْوَى مُعَارِضِهَا ۞ رَدَّ الْغَيُورِ يَدَ الْجَانِي عَنِ الْحُرَمِ
verses.tr: Raddat balāghatuhā daʿwā muʿāriḍihā · Raddal ghayūri yadal jānī ʿanil ḥurami
verses.en: Their eloquence repelled the claim of the challenger as a jealous man repels the aggressor's hand from his womenfolk.

verses.ar: لَهَا مَعَانٍ كَمَوْجِ الْبَحْرِ فِي مَدَدٍ ۞ وَفَوْقَ جَوْهَرِهِ فِي الْحُسْنِ وَالقِيَمِ
verses.tr: Lahā maʿānin ka mawjil baḥri fī madadin · Wa fawqa jawharihi fīl ḥusni wal qiyami
verses.en: They hold meanings like the sea's waves in their surging, surpassing its pearls in beauty and in worth.

verses.ar: فَمَا تُعَدُّ وَلاَ تُحْصَى عَجَائِبُهَا ۞ وَلاَ تُسَامُ عَلٰى الْإِكْثَارِ بِالسَّأَمِ
verses.tr: Famā tuʿaddu wa lā tuḥṣā ʿajāʾibuhā · Wa lā tusāmu ʿalal ikthāri bis saʾami
verses.en: Their wonders cannot be counted or numbered, nor does much repetition of them ever breed weariness.

verses.ar: قَرَّتْ بِهَا عَيْنُ قَارِيْهَا فَقُلْتُ لَهُ ۞ لَقَدْ ظَفِرْتَ بِحَبْلِ اللّٰهِ فَاعْتَصِمِ
verses.tr: Qarrat bihā ʿaynu qārīhā fa qultu lahu · Laqad ẓafirta bi ḥabliLlāhi faʿtaṣimi
verses.en: They delight the eye of their reciter, so I said to him: 'You have won the Rope of Allah, so hold fast to it.'

verses.ar: إِنْ تَتْلُهَا خِيفَةً مِنْ حَرَّ نَارِ لَظَى ۞ أَطْفَأْتَ حَرِّ لَظَىَ مِنْ وِرْدِهَا الشَّبِمِ
verses.tr: In tatluhā khīfatan min ḥarri nāri laẓā · Aṭfaʾta ḥarra laẓā min wirdihash shabimi
verses.en: If you recite them in fear of the heat of the blazing Fire, you quench that heat with their cool water.

verses.ar: كَأَنَّهَا الْحَوْضُ تَبْيَضُّ الْوُجُوهُ بِهِ ۞ مِنَ الْعُصَاةِ وَقَدْ جَاءُوهُ كَالحُمَمِ
verses.tr: Ka annahal ḥawḍu tabyaḍḍul wujūhu bihi · Minal ʿuṣāti wa qad jāʾūhu kal ḥumami
verses.en: They are like the Pool at which the faces of sinners turn white, though they had come to it black as charcoal.

verses.ar: وَكَالصِّرَاطِ وَكَالمِيزَانِ مَعْدِلَةً ۞ فَالقِسْطُ مِنْ غَيْرِهَا فِي النَّاسِ لَمْ يَقُمِ
verses.tr: Wa kaṣṣirāṭi wa kalmīzāni maʿdalatan · Falqisṭu min ghayrihā fin nāsi lam yaqumi
verses.en: And like the Bridge and like the Balance in justice — for without them true equity among people could not stand.

verses.ar: لاَ تَعْجَبَنْ لِحَسُودٍ رَاحَ يُنْكِرُهَا ۞ تَجَاهُلاً وَهْوَ عَيْنُ الْحَاذِقِ الْفَهِمِ
verses.tr: Lā taʿjaban liḥasūdin rāḥa yunkiruhā · Tajāhulan wa huwa ʿaynul ḥādhiqil fahimi
verses.en: Do not wonder at an envier who goes on denying them, feigning ignorance while he is the very picture of the shrewd and discerning.

verses.ar: قَدْ تُنْكِرُ الْعَيْنُ ضَوْءَ الشَّمْسِ مِنْ رَمَدٍ ۞ وَيُنْكِرُ الْفَمُ طَعْمَ الْمَاءِ مِنْ سَقَمِ
verses.tr: Qad tunkirul ʿaynu ḍawʾash shamsi min ramadin · Wa yunkirul famu ṭaʿmal māʾi min saqami
verses.en: The eye may reject the light of the sun on account of inflammation, and the mouth may reject the taste of water on account of illness.

titleEnglish: 7 · On the Night Journey and Ascension

verses.ar: يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ يَمَّمَ الْعّافُونَ سَاحَتَهُ ۞ سَعْيًا وَفَوْقَ مُتُونِ الْأَيْنُقِ الرُّسُمِ
verses.tr: Yā Khayra man yammamal ʿāfūna sāḥatahu · Saʿyan wa fawqa mutūnil aynuqir rusumi
verses.en: O best of those to whose courtyard the seekers make their way — on foot and on the backs of sturdy, tireless she-camels!

verses.ar: وَمَنْ هُوَ الْآيَةُ الْكُبْرَى لِمُعْتَبِرٍ ۞ وَمَنْ هُوَ النِّعْمَةُ الْعُظْمَى لِمُغْتَنِمِ
verses.tr: Wa man huwal āyatul kubrā limuʿtabirin · Wa man huwan niʿmatul ʿuẓmā limughtanimi
verses.en: He who is the greatest sign for the one who reflects, and the supreme blessing for the one who would seize it.

verses.ar: سَرَيْتَ مِنْ حَرَمٍ لَيْلاً إِلَى حَرَمٍ ۞ كَمَا سَرَى الْبَدْرُ فِي دَاجٍ مِنَ الظُّلَمِ
verses.tr: Sarayta min ḥaramin laylan ilā ḥaramin · Kamā saral badru fī dājin minaẓ ẓulami
verses.en: By night you journeyed from one sanctuary to another, as the full moon journeys through the deepest dark.

verses.ar: وَبِتَّ تَرْقَى إِلَى أَنْ نِلْتَ مَنْزِلَةً ۞ مِنْ قَابِ قَوْسَيْنِ لَمْ تُدْرَكْ وَلَمْ تُرَمِ
verses.tr: Wa bitta tarqā ilā an nilta manzilatan · Min qābi qawsayni lam tudrak wa lam turami
verses.en: You rose all night until you reached a station 'two bows' length' away — never attained by any other, nor even aspired to.

verses.ar: وَقَدَّمَتْكَ جَمِيعُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ بِهَا ۞ وَالرُّسْلِ تَقْدِيمَ مَخْدُومٍ عَلٰى خَدَمِ
verses.tr: Wa qaddamatka jamīʿul anbiyāʾi bihā · War rusli taqdīma makhdūmin ʿalā khadami
verses.en: There all the Prophets and Messengers set you before them, as the one served is set before those who serve.

verses.ar: وَأَنْتَ تَخْتَرِقُ السَّبْعَ الطِّبَاقَ بِهِمْ ۞ فِي مَوْكِبٍ كُنْتَ فِيهِ الصَّاحِبَ الْعَلَمِ
verses.tr: Wa anta takhtariqus sabʿaṭ ṭibāqa bihim · Fī mawkibin kunta fīhi ṣāhibal ʿalami
verses.en: And you passed through the seven heavens with them, in a procession in which you were the bearer of the banner.

verses.ar: حَتَّى إِذَا لَمْ تَدَعْ شَأْوًا لِمُسْتَبِقٍ ۞ مِنَ الدُّنُوِّ وَلاَ مَرْقَى لِمُسْتَنِمِ
verses.tr: Ḥattā idhā lam tadaʿ shaʾwan limustabiqin · Minad dunuwwi wa lā marqan li mustanimi
verses.en: Until you left no goal of nearness for any who would race toward it, and no ascent for any who would climb.

verses.ar: خَفَضْتَ كُلَّ مَقَامٍ بِالإِضَافَةٍ إِذْ ۞ نُودِيْتَ بِالرَّفْعِ مِثْلَ الْمُفْرَدِ الْعَلَمِ
verses.tr: Khafaḍta kulla maqāmin bil iḍāfati idh · Nūdīta bir rafʿi mithlal mufradil ʿalami
verses.en: You lowered every rank by comparison, when you were called up on high, like the single, matchless proper name.

verses.ar: كَيْمَا تَفُوزَ بِوَصْلٍ أَيِّ مُسْتَتِرٍ ۞ عَنْ الْعُيُونِ وَسِرٍّ أَيِّ مُكْتَتَمِ
verses.tr: Kaymā tafūza biwaṣlin ayyi mustatirin · ʿAnil ʿuyūni wa sirrin ayyi muktatami
verses.en: So that you might attain a union — how hidden from all eyes! — and a secret — how deeply concealed!

verses.ar: فَحُزْتَ كُلَّ فَخَارٍ غَيْرَ مُشْتَرَكٍ ۞ وَجُزْتَ كُلَّ مَقَامٍ غَيْرَ مُزْدَحَمِ
verses.tr: Fa ḥuzta kulla fakhārin ghayra mushtarakin · Wa juzta kulla maqāmin ghayra muzdaḥami
verses.en: So you gained every glory, shared with none, and passed through every station, crowded by none.

verses.ar: وَجَلَّ مِقْدَارُ مَا وُلِّيتَ مِنْ رُتَبٍ ۞ وَعَزَّ إِدْرَاكُ مَا أُولِيْتَ مِنْ نِعَمِ
verses.tr: Wa jalla miqdāru mā wullīta min rutabin · Wa ʿazza idrāku mā ūlīta min niʿami
verses.en: How immense the measure of the ranks you were given, and how far beyond grasp the blessings bestowed on you!

verses.ar: بُشْرَى لَنَا مَعْشَرَ الْإِسْلَامِ إِنَّ لَنَا ۞ مِنَ الْعِنَايَةِ رُكْنًا غَيْرَ مُنْهَدِمِ
verses.tr: Bushrā lanā maʿsharal islāmi inna lanā · Minal ʿināyati ruknan ghayra munhadimi
verses.en: Glad tidings for us, O people of Islam: we have, through divine care, a pillar that will never fall.

verses.ar: لَمَّا دَعَا اللّٰهُ دَاعِينَا لِطَاعَتِهِ ۞ بِأَكْرَمِ الرُّسْلِ كُنَّا أَكْرَمَ الْأُمَمِ
verses.tr: Lammā daʿāLlāhu dāʿīnā liṭāʿatihi · Bi akramir rusli kunna akramal umami
verses.en: When Allah called the one who calls us to His obedience the noblest of Messengers, we became the noblest of nations.

verses.ar: رَاعَتْ قُلُوبَ الْعِدَا أَنْبَاءُ بِعْثَتِهِ ۞ كَنَبْأَةٍ أَجْفَلَتْ غُفْلاً مِنَ الْغَنَمِ
verses.tr: Rāʿat qulūbal ʿidā anbāʾu biʿthatihi · Kanabʾatin ajfalat ghuflan minal ghanami
verses.en: The tidings of his sending struck terror into the hearts of the enemies, like a sudden sound that scatters heedless sheep.

verses.ar: مَا زَالَ يَلْقَاهُمُ فِي كُلِّ مُعْتَرَكٍ ۞ حَتَّى حَكَوْا بِالْقَنَا لَحْمًا عَلٰى وَضَمِ
verses.tr: Mā zāla yalqāhumu fī kulli muʿtarakin · Ḥattā ḥakaw bil qanā laḥman ʿalā waḍami
verses.en: He kept meeting them on every field of battle, until the spears left them like meat on a butcher's block.

verses.ar: وَدُّوا الْفِرَارَ فَكَادُوا يَغْبِطُونَ بِهِ ۞ أَشْلاَءَ شَالَتْ مَعَ الْعِقْبَانِ وَالرَّخَمِ
verses.tr: Waddul firāra fakādū yaghbiṭūna bihi · Ashlāʾa shālat maʿal ʿiqbāni war rakhami
verses.en: They longed to flee, till they almost envied the torn limbs borne aloft by the eagles and the vultures.

verses.ar: تَمْضِي اللَّيَالِي وَلاَ يَدْرُونَ عِدَّتَهَا ۞ مَا لَمْ تَكُنْ مِنْ لَيَالِي الْأَشْهُرِ الْحُرُمِ
verses.tr: Tamḍil layālī wa lā yadrūna ʿiddatahā · Mā lam takun min layālil ash-huril ḥurumi
verses.en: The nights passed and they could not reckon their number — unless they were nights of the Sacred Months.

verses.ar: كَأَنَّمَا الدِّينُ ضَيْفٌ حَلَّ سَاحَتَهُمْ ۞ بِكُلِّ قَرْمٍ إِلَى لَحْمِ الْعِدَا قَرِمِ
verses.tr: Ka annamad dīnu ḍayfun ḥalla sāḥatahum · Bi kulli qarmin ilā laḥmil ʿidā qarimi
verses.en: As if the Religion were a guest that alighted in their courtyard, borne by every chieftain hungry for the flesh of the foe.

verses.ar: يَجُرُّ بَحْرَ خَمِيسٍ فَوْقَ سَابِحَةٍ ۞ يَرْمِى بِمَوْجٍ مِنَ الْأَبْطَالِ مُلْتَطِمِ
verses.tr: Yajurru baḥra khamīsin fawqa sābiḥatin · Yarmī bi mawjin minal abṭāli multaṭimi
verses.en: Leading a sea of soldiers upon swift steeds, casting forth wave upon crashing wave of heroes.

verses.ar: مِنْ كُلِّ مُنْتَدَبٍ لِلّٰهِ مُحْتَسِبٍ ۞ يَسْطُو بِمُسْتَأْصِلٍ لِلكُفْرِ مُصْطَلِمِ
verses.tr: Min kulli muntadabin liLlāhi muḥtasibin · Yasṭū bimustaʾṣilin lil kufri muṣṭalimi
verses.en: Every one of them answering Allah's call and seeking His reward, striking to uproot disbelief and wipe it out.

verses.ar: حَتىَّ غَدَتْ مِلَّةُ الْإِسْلاَمِ وَهْيَ بِهِمْ ۞ مِنْ بَعْدِ غُرْبَتِهَا مَوْصُولَةَ الرَّحِمِ
verses.tr: Ḥatta ghadat millatul islāmi wahya bihim · Min baʿdi ghurbatihā mawṣūlatar rahimi
verses.en: Until, through them, the community of Islam became — after its estrangement — a kinship rejoined.

verses.ar: مَكْفُولَةً أَبَدًا مِنْهُمْ بِخَيْرِ أَبٍ ۞ وَخَيْرِ بَعْلٍ فَلَمْ تَيْتَمْ وَلَمْ تَئِمِ
verses.tr: Makfūlatan abadan minhum bi khayri abin · Wa khayri baʿlin fa lam taytam wa lam taʾimi
verses.en: Forever safeguarded by them, through the best of fathers and the best of husbands, so it was neither orphaned nor widowed.

verses.ar: هُمُ الْجِبَالُ فَسَلْ عَنْهُمْ مُصَادِمَهُمْ ۞ مَاذَا رَأَى مِنْهُمُ فِي كُلِّ مُصْطَدَمِ
verses.tr: Humul jibālu fasal ʿanhum muṣādimahum · Mādhā raʾā minhumu fī kulli muṣṭadami
verses.en: They were mountains — so ask of them the one who clashed with them what he witnessed of them in every collision.

verses.ar: وَسَلْ حُنَيْنًا وَسَلْ بَدْرًا وَسَلْ أُحُدًا ۞ فُصُولَ حَتْفٍ لَهُمْ أَدْهَى مِنَ الْوَخَمِ
verses.tr: Wa sal ḥunaynan wa sal badran wa sal uḥudan · Fuṣūla ḥatfin lahum adʾhā minal wakhami
verses.en: Ask Ḥunayn, and ask Badr, and ask Uḥud — seasons of death for them, more grievous than any plague.

verses.ar: الْمُصْدِرِي الْبِيضِ حُمْرًا بَعْدَ مَا وَرَدَتْ ۞ مِنَ الْعِدَا كُلَّ مُسْوَدٍّ مِنَ اللِّمَمِ
verses.tr: Almuṣdiril bīḍi ḥumran baʿda mā waradat · Minal ʿidā kulla muswaddin minal limami
verses.en: They drew back their white blades stained red, after they had gone in among the enemy's every dark head of hair.

verses.ar: وَالكَاتِبِينَ بِسُمْرِ الْخَطِّ مَا تَرَكَتْ ۞ أَقْلاَمُهُمْ حَرْفَ جِسْمٍ غَيْرَ مُنَعَجِمِ
verses.tr: Wal kātibīna bi sumril khaṭṭi mā tarakat · Aqlāmuhum ḥarfa jismin ghayra munʿajimi
verses.en: Writing with the brown shafts of their spears, their pens left no letter of a body without its mark.

verses.ar: شَاكِي السِّلاَحِ لَهُمْ سِيمَا تُمَيِّزُهُمْ ۞ وَالوَرْدُ يَمْتَازُ بِالسِّيمَا عَنِ السَّلَمِ
verses.tr: Shākis silāḥi lahum sīmā tumayyizuhum · Wal wardu yamtāzu bis sīmā ʿanis salami
verses.en: Fully armed, they bore a mark that set them apart — as the rose is set apart by its mark from the acacia.

verses.ar: تُهْدِي إِلَيْكَ رِيَاحُ النَّصْرِ نَشْرَهُمُ ۞ فَتَحْسَبُ الزَّهْرَ فِي الْأَكْمَامِ كُلَّ كَمِي
verses.tr: Tuhdī ilayka riyāḥun naṣri nashrahumu · Fataḥsabuz zahra fīl akmāmi kulla kamī
verses.en: The winds of victory bring you their fragrance, till you would take every armoured hero for a flower in its bud.

verses.ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ فِي ظُهُورِ الْخَيْلِ نَبْتُ رُبًا ۞ مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْحَزْمِ لاَ مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْحُزُمِ
verses.tr: Ka annahum fī ẓuhūril khayli nabtu ruban · Min shiddatil ḥazmi lā min shiddatil ḥuzumi
verses.en: On the backs of their steeds they seemed like plants rooted on a hill — held firm by the strength of resolve, not the strength of saddle-girths.

verses.ar: طَارَتْ قُلُوبُ الْعِدَا مِنْ بَأْسِهِمْ فَرَقًا ۞ فَمَا تُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ الْبَهْمِ وَالبُهُمِ
verses.tr: Ṭārat qulūbul ʿidā min baʾsihim faraqan · Famā tufarriqu baynal bahmi wal buhami
verses.en: The hearts of the foe took flight in terror at their might, so that they could not tell the lambs from the armoured warriors.

verses.ar: وَمَنْ تَكُنْ بِرَسُولِ اللّٰهِ نُصْرَتُهُ ۞ إِنْ تَلْقَهُ الْأُسْدُ فِي آجَامِهَا تَجِمِ
verses.tr: Wa man takun birasūliLlāhi nuṣratuhu · In talqahul usdu fī ājāmihā tajimi
verses.en: Whoever's help comes through the Emissary of Allah — should the lions meet him in their thickets, they fall silent and cower.

verses.ar: وَلَنْ تَرَى مِنْ وَليٍّ غَيْرِ مُنْتَصِرٍ ۞ بِهِ وَلاَ مِنْ عَدُوٍّ غَيْرِ مُنْقَصِمِ
verses.tr: Wa lan tarā min waliyyin ghayri muntaṣirin · Bihi wa lā min ʿaduwwin ghayri munqasimi
verses.en: You will see no friend of his who is not made victorious through him, and no foe who is not broken.

verses.ar: أَحَلَّ أُمَّتَهُ فِي حِرْزِ مِلَّتِهِ ۞ كَاللَّيْثِ حَلَّ مَعَ الْأَشْبَالِ فِي أَجَمِ
verses.tr: Aḥalla ummatahu fī ḥirzi millatihi · Kal laythi ḥalla maʿal ashbāli fī ajami
verses.en: He settled his community within the stronghold of his faith, as the lion settles with its cubs in the thicket.

verses.ar: كَمْ جَدَّلَتْ كَلِمَاتُ اللّٰهِ مِنْ جَدَلٍ ۞ فِيهِ وَكَمْ خَصَمَ الْبُرْهَانُ مِنْ خَصِمِ
verses.tr: Kam jaddalat kalimātuLlāhi min jadilin · Fīhi wa kam khaṣamal burhānu min khaṣimi
verses.en: How many a disputer the words of Allah have thrown down concerning him, and how many an adversary the proof has defeated!

verses.ar: كَفَاكَ بِالْعِلْمِ فِي الْأُمِّيِّ مُعْجِزَةً ۞ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ وَالتَّأْدِيبِ فِي الْيُتُمِ
verses.tr: Kafāka bil ʿilmi fīl ummiyyi muʿjizatan · Fīl jāhiliyyati wat taʾdībi fīl yutumi
verses.en: Knowledge in one unlettered is miracle enough for you — in an age of ignorance — as is refinement in one orphaned.

verses.ar: خَدَمْتُهُ بِمَدِيحٍ أَسْتَقِيلُ بِهِ ۞ ذُنُوبَ عُمْرٍ مَضَى فِي الشِّعْرِ وَالخِدَمِ
verses.tr: Khadamtuhu bi madīḥin astaqīlu bihi · Dhunūba ʿumrin maḍā fish shiʿri wal khidami
verses.en: I have served him with a praise by which I seek release from the sins of a life spent in poetry and in service to patrons.

verses.ar: إِذْ قَلَّدَانِيَ مَا تُخْشَى عَوَاقِبُهُ ۞ كَأَنَّنِي بِهِمَا هَدْىٌ مِنَ النَّعَمِ
verses.tr: Idh qalladāniya mā tukhshā ʿawāqibuhu · Ka annanī bihimā hadyun minan naʿami
verses.en: For those two draped upon me a burden whose consequences are feared, as though, through them, I were a sacrificial beast led to the offering.

verses.ar: أَطَعْتُ غَيَّ الصِّبَا فِي الْحَالَتَيْنِ وَمَا ۞ حَصَلْتُ إِلْاَّ عَلٰى الْآثَامِ وَالنَّدَمِ
verses.tr: Aṭaʿtu ghayyaṣ ṣibā fīl ḥālatayni wa mā · Ḥaṣaltu illā ʿalal āthāmi wan nadami
verses.en: In both states I obeyed the folly of youth, and gained nothing but sins and regret.

verses.ar: فَيَا خَسَارَةَ نَفْسٍ فِي تِجَارَتِهَا ۞ لَمْ تَشْتَرِ الدِّينَ بِالدُّنْيَا وَلَمْ تَسُمِ
verses.tr: Fayā khasārata nafsin fī tijāratihā · Lam tashtarid dīna bid dunyā wal lam tasumi
verses.en: O what a loss for a soul in its trade — it did not buy the faith with this world, nor even make an offer!

verses.ar: وَمَنْ يَبِعْ آجِلاً مِنْهُ بِعَاجِلِهِ ۞ يَبِنْ لَهُ الْغَبْنُ فِي بَيْعٍ وَفِي سَلَمِ
verses.tr: Wa man yabiʿ ājilan minhu bi ʿājilihi · Yabin lahul ghabnu fī bayʿin wa fī salami
verses.en: Whoever sells what is to come for what is at hand, the loss becomes plain to him, in the sale and in the bargain.

verses.ar: إِنْ آتِ ذَنْبًا فَمَا عَهْدِي بِمُنْتَقِضٍ ۞ مَنَ النَّبِيِّ وَلاَ حَبْلِي بِمُنْصَرِمِ
verses.tr: In āti dhanban famā ʿahdī bimuntaqiḍin · Minan nabiyyi wa lā ḥablī bimunṣarimi
verses.en: If I commit a sin, my covenant with the Prophet is not thereby broken, nor is my rope to him cut.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّ لِي ذِمَّةً مِنْهُ بِتَسْمِيَتيِ ۞ مُحَمَّداً وَهْوَ أَوْفَى الْخَلْقِ بِالذِّمَمِ
verses.tr: Fa inna lī dhimmatan minhu bi tasmiyatī · Muḥammadan wa huwa awfāl khalqi bidh dhimami
verses.en: For I hold a pledge of protection from him through my being named Muhammad — and he is the most faithful of creation to his pledges.

verses.ar: إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِي مَعَادِي آخِذًا بِيَدِي ۞ فَضْلاً وَإِلاَّ فَقُلْ يَا زَلَّةَ الْقَدَمِ
verses.tr: In lam yakun fī maʿādī ākhidhan bi yadī · Faḍlan wa illā faqul yā zallatal qadami
verses.en: If, in my Return, he does not take me by the hand out of grace — then say: O what a slip of the foot!

verses.ar: حَاشَاهُ أَنْ يَحْرِمَ الرَّاجِي مَكَارِمَهُ ۞ أَوْ يَرْجِعَ الْجَارُ مِنْهُ غَيْرَ مُحْتَرَمِ
verses.tr: Ḥāshāhu an yaḥrimar rājī makārimahu · Aw yarjiʿal jāru minhu ghayra muḥtarami
verses.en: Far be it from him to deny the hopeful one his bounties, or to let a neighbour turn back from him unhonoured.

verses.ar: وَمُنْذُ أَلْزَمْتُ أَفْكَارِي مَدَائِحَهُ ۞ وَجَدْتُهُ لِخَلاَصِي خَيْرَ مُلْتَزِمِ
verses.tr: Wa mundhu alzamtu afkārī madāʾiḥahu · Wajadtuhu likhalāṣī khayra multazimi
verses.en: Ever since I bound my thoughts to his praises, I have found him the best guarantor of my deliverance.

verses.ar: وَلَنْ يَفُوتَ الْغِنَى مِنْهُ يَدًا تَرِبَتْ ۞ إِنَّ الْحَيَا يُنْبِتَ الْأَزْهَارَ فِي الْأَكَمِ
verses.tr: Wa lan yafūtal ghinā minhu yadan taribat · Innal ḥayā yunbitul azhāra fīl akami
verses.en: His riches will not pass by a dust-poor hand — for the rain brings flowers to bloom even upon the hilltops.

verses.ar: وَلَمْ أُرِدْ زَهْرَةَ الدُّنْيَا الَّتيِ اقْتَطَفَتْ ۞ يَدَا زُهَيْرٍ بِمَا أَثْنَى عَلٰى هَرِمِ
verses.tr: Wa lam urid zahratad dunyal latiqtaṭafat · Yadā zuhayrin bimā athnā ʿalā harimi
verses.en: I did not seek the bloom of this world that the hands of Zuhayr plucked in return for his praise of Harim.

verses.ar: يَا أَكْرَمَ الْخَلْقِ مَالَي مَنْ أَلُوذُ بِهِ ۞ سِوَاكَ عِنْدَ حُلُولِ الْحَادِثِ الْعَمِمِ
verses.tr: Yā akramal khalqi mālī man alūdhu bihi · Siwāka ʿinda ḥulūlil ḥādithil ʿamimi
verses.en: O noblest of creation, I have no one to shelter with but you when the all-encompassing event descends.

verses.ar: وَلَنْ يَضِيقَ رَسُولَ اللّٰهِ جَاهُكَ بيِ ۞ إِذَا الْكَرِيمُ تَجَلَّى بِاسْمِ مُنْتَقِمِ
verses.tr: Wa lan yaḍīqa rasūlaLlāhi jāhuka bī · Idhal karīmu tajjalā bismi muntaqimi
verses.en: O Emissary of Allah, your standing will not fall short of me when the Generous One appears under the name of the Avenger.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّ مِنْ جُودِكَ الدُّنْيَا وَضَرَّتَهَا ۞ وَمِنْ عُلُومِكَ عِلْمَ اللَّوْحِ وَالقَلَمِ
verses.tr: Fa inna min jūdikad dunyā wa ḍarratahā · Wa min ʿulūmika ʿilmal lawḥi wal qalami
verses.en: For of your bounty is this world and the next, and of your knowledge is the knowledge of the Tablet and the Pen.

verses.ar: يَا نَفْسُ لاَ تَقْنَطِي مِنْ زَلَّةٍ عَظُمَتْ ۞ إَنَّ الْكَبَائِرَ فِي الْغُفْرَانِ كَاللَّمَمِ
verses.tr: Yā nafsu lā taqnaṭī min zallatin ʿaẓumat · Innal kabāʾira fīl ghufrāni kal lamami
verses.en: O soul, do not despair over a fault however great — before forgiveness, grave sins are as the slightest.

verses.ar: لَعَلَّ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّي حِينَ يَقْسِمُهَا ۞ تَأْتِي عَلٰى حَسَبِ الْعِصْيَانِ فِي الْقِسَمِ
verses.tr: Laʿalla raḥmata rabbī ḥīna yaqsimuhā · Taʾtī ʿalā ḥasabil ʿiṣyāni fīl qisami
verses.en: Perhaps my Lord's mercy, when He apportions it, will come in measure with the extent of the sins.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ وَاجْعَلْ رَجَائِي غَيْرَ مُنْعَكِسٍ ۞ لَدَيْكَ وَاجْعَلْ حِسَابِي غَيْرَ مُنْخَرِمِ
verses.tr: Yā rabbi wajʿal rajāʾī ghayra munʿakisin · Ladayka wajʿal ḥisābī ghayra munkharimi
verses.en: O my Lord, let not my hope in You be turned back, and let not my account be found wanting.

verses.ar: وَالْطُفْ بِعَبْدِكَ فِي الدَّارَيْنِ إَنَّ لَهُ ۞ صَبْرًا مَتَى تَدْعُهُ الْأَهْوَالُ يَنْهَزِمِ
verses.tr: Walṭuf biʿabdika fid dārayni inna lahu · Ṣabran matā tadʿuhul ahwālu yanhazimi
verses.en: Be gentle with Your servant in both abodes, for his patience takes flight whenever terrors summon it.

verses.ar: وَأْذَنْ لِسُحْبِ صَلاَةٍ مِنْكَ دَائِمَةٍ ۞ عَلٰى النَّبِيِّ بِمُنْهَلٍّ وَمُنْسَجِمِ
verses.tr: Waʾdhan lisuḥbi ṣalātin minka dāʾimatin · ʿAlan nabiyyi bimunhallin wa munsajimi
verses.en: And grant leave to clouds of unceasing blessing from You to pour upon the Prophet, in downpour and in steady stream.

verses.ar: مَا رَنَّحَتْ عَذَبَاتِ الْبَانِ رِيحُ صَبًا ۞ وَأَطْرَبَ الْعِيسَ حَادِي الْعِيسِ بِالنَّغَمِ
verses.tr: Mā rannaḥat ʿadhabātil bāni rīḥu ṣaban · Wa aṭrabal ʿīsa ḥādil ʿīsi bin naghami
verses.en: For as long as the east wind sways the tender willow branches, and the camel-driver gladdens the camels with his song.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ الرِّضَا عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعَنْ عُمَرٍ ۞ وَعَنْ عَلِيٍّ وَعَنْ عُثْمَانَ ذِي الْكَرَمِ
verses.tr: Thummar riḍā ʿan abī bakrin wa ʿan ʿumarin · Wa ʿan ʿaliyyin wa ʿan ʿuthmāna dhil karami
verses.en: Then may Your pleasure rest on Abu Bakr and on ʿUmar, and on ʿAli, and on ʿUthman, the generous.

verses.ar: وَالآلِ وَالصَّحْبِ ثُمَّ التَّابِعِيَن فَهُمْ ۞ أَهْلُ التُّقَى وَالنَّقَا وَالحِلْمِ وَالْكَرَمِ
verses.tr: Wal āli waṣ ṣaḥbi thummat tābiʿīna fahum · Ahlut tuqā wan naqā wal ḥilmi wal karami
verses.en: And on the Family and the Companions, then the Followers — for they are the people of piety, purity, forbearance and nobility.

verses.ar: يِا رَبِّ بِالمُصْطَفَى بَلِّغْ مَقَاصِدَنَا ۞ وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا مَا مَضَى يَا وَاسِعَ الْكَرَمِ
verses.tr: Yā rabbi bil muṣṭafā balligh maqāṣidanā · Waghfir lanā mā maḍā yā wāsiʿal karami
verses.en: O Lord, by the Chosen One, bring us to our goals, and forgive us what has passed, O Vast in generosity.

verses.ar: وَاغْفِرْ إِلَهِي لِكُلِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ بِمَا ۞ يَتْلُونَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْأَقْصَى وَفِي الْحَرَمِ
verses.tr: Waghfir ilāhī li kullil muslimīna bimā · Yatluna fīl masjidil aqṣā wa fīl ḥarami
verses.en: And forgive, O my God, all the Muslims, by virtue of what they recite in the Farthest Mosque and in the Sacred Mosque.

verses.ar: بِجَاهِ مَنْ بَيْتُهُ فِي طَيْبَةٍ حَرَمٌ ۞ وَاسْمُهُ قَسَمٌ مِنْ أَعْظَمِ الْقَسَمِ
verses.tr: Bijāhi man baytuhu fī ṭaybatin ḥaramun · Wasmuhu qasamun min aʿẓamil qasami
verses.en: By the rank of him whose house in Ṭayba is a sanctuary, and whose name is an oath — among the mightiest of oaths.

verses.ar: وَهٰذِهِ بُرْدَةُ الْمُخْتَارِ قَدْ خُتِمَتْ ۞ وَالحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ فِي بَدْءٍ وَفِي خَتَمِ
verses.tr: Wa hādhihi burdatul mukhtāri qad khutimat · Walḥamdu liLlāhi fī badʾin wa fī khatami
verses.en: This is the Mantle-Ode of the Chosen One, now brought to a close; and praise be to Allah at the beginning and at the end.

verses.ar: أَبْيَاتُهَا قَدْ أَتَتْ سِتِّينَ مَعْ مِائَةٍ ۞ فَرِّجْ بِهَا كَرْبَنَا يَا وَاسِعَ الْكَرَمِ
verses.tr: Abyātuhā qad atat sittīna maʿ miʾatin · Farrij bihā karbanā yā wāsiʿal karami
verses.en: Its verses have come to one hundred and sixty; through them relieve our distress, O Vast in generosity.
